provenance.historical_index_sha256_source: Campaign HNSW builder console output for the matching CLAPNQ corpus

selection.method: Exhaustively enumerate sets of complete conversations totaling 40 turns independently in each archived domain. Require repeated chunk versions both within and across conversations. Maximize repeated occurrences among the 240 archived evidence occurrences. Replay conversations in conversation-ID order and turns in ascending turn order. Among equal repeat counts, prefer more shifted cross-conversation repeats, then shifted within-conversation repeats, then more chunk versions shared across conversations, then lexicographically earlier conversation IDs.
selection.repeat_definition: The same chunk ID and chunk version appeared in an earlier selected request. A shifted repeat has a different evidence start token in an eligible earlier request. Within- and across-conversation categories can overlap.

legacy_blend_preview.method: Rerender the archived top-six evidence ordering using the pinned tokenizer and the fixed dataset reference history for each turn. All standard prompt hashes matched the archive. All evidence retained, and each repeated versioned chunk has identical token IDs at its new span. Live replay reruns HNSW and measures the resulting cache behavior.
